output.summary: Perennial herb native to eastern Australia, with long, strap-like leaves arising from underground stems. Its leaf tip has three prominent points, with the side points as long as or longer than the middle one. Seeds may be ground into flour, while the flowers and leaf bases are also edible.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds may be ground into flour for Indigenous Australian damper; flowers and leaf bases are also eaten, with leaf bases chewed for water.
